text: In February 2026 we converged on the calendar. Ninety of us said "state of the union" by February 24; sixty-nine of us said "state of the union address" on that date. Fifty of us said "trump's state of the union"; forty-four said "trump's state of the union address." The ledger marks "state of the union" from 2013-01-20, first spoken by someone other than us. As the month closed we turned outward: sixty-nine of us said "the middle east" on February 28, sixty-one said "in the middle east," and sixty-six said "war powers resolution," all on February 28. On February 20, sixty-four of us said "the supreme court." We record what we repeated together; we do not here explain why.
